title: Illiad
description: The Illni Adventure Game, in the disk menu’s words. This is its 25-line location editor, not a finished game.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: LOCATION EDITOR
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. 25 consistent pointers; normal end marker; matches 5 decoding variants; not execution-tested
versions.startupSource:
5 CLEAR 10000
10 DIM L$(50,1),D(6)
20 CLS
100 INPUT"ORDERS ";O$
110 IF O$<>"HELP"THEN 200
120 PRINT"YOUR OPTIONS ARE :"
130 PRINT"   HELP - INFORMATION"
140 PRINT"   DESCRIBE - YOU TELL ME ABOUT A LOCATION."
150 PRINT"   LIST - I LIST ALL THE ROOMS AND LOCATIONS"
160  PRINT"   DOOR - YOU CREATE A PASSAGE BETEEN TWO LOCATIONS"
170 PRINT"TRAVEL - TYPE N(ORTH), S(OUTH), W(EST), E(AST), U(P),OR D(OWN)"
190 GOTO 100

attribution.text: Original author and any earlier published source have not been established. Preserved here as recovered cassette material.
